newsitem.title: USA: Lexus names new sport utility vehicle RX 300.
newsitem.headline: Lexus names new sport utility vehicle RX 300.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp.'s Lexus Division said the new car-based luxury sport utility vehicle it will introduce next year will be called the RX 300.

Based on the Sport Luxury Vehicle concept unveiled last month in Chicago, the mid-sized sport utility vehicle aims to combine the ride and comfort of a luxury car with increased ground clearance, four-wheel drive performance and a rugged-looking sport utility body. Pricing is expected in the mid-$30,000 range.

Based on the Lexus ES 300 luxury sedan chassis, the RX 300 is powered by a new all-aluminum 3.0-liter 24-valve V6 engine. Toyota announced the name in advance of the New York Auto Show press previews, which start Wednesday.
